description.value: Nesters Market is a full-service neighbourhood supermarket in Squamish, part of a BC-founded chain now operating 16+ locations across Western Canada under the Pattison Food Group. The Squamish location offers a broad range of groceries alongside in-store departments including a bakery, deli and bistro, pharmacy, and health and wellness section. For touring cyclists passing through Squamish, it represents a well-stocked resupply point with fresh produce, natural and organic products, and prepared food options.
